name: Research, Knowledge and Learning
blurb: How the field explains itself: papers and their venues, books, courses and certifications, the skills graph, the glossary and taxonomy, and the media record of talks and podcasts.

domains.name: AI Research Library
domains.blurb: The AI Research Library is a growing collection of peer-reviewed and preprint AI papers, curated through the Consensus academic index and organised into topics from architectures and reasoning to bias, evaluation, security and the EU AI Act. Every entry carries its authors, venue, year, and citation count, plus a short plain-English note on why the paper matters. A dedicated page per paper adds the abstract with Consensus attribution and three tailored explanations, one for a beginner, one for a practitioner, and one for a business reader. The library refreshes daily from the same pipeline that runs the rest of the site, so the citation counts and additions stay current. Every source cited anywhere on The World of AI is discoverable from the companion Sources page.
